actions.outputs: Per-check expected/observed values, units, method, numerical threshold and PASS/FAIL; invalid expectations raise ValueError
actions.prerequisites: Actual source-pinned component expectations and measured native geometry; source and geometry identities retained by caller

actions.changed_or_inferred: Repeated comparison rules extracted into shared Python functions; component data remains external
